content.value: Become a certified Mom Helper, set your own services and rates, work when and where you choose, and support families in your community, every one of them verified before they can message you.
“I set my rate, I pick my hours, and I know every family I talk to has been checked. That changes how the first visit feels.”
Flexible Work That Fits Your Life
Every service has its own hourly rate in CAD, chosen by you. Change it whenever you like.
Households complete a safety check before they can find or message you.
Hours, rate and scope go into a plain-language agreement before the first session.
Families find you by distance. Work in your own neighbourhood, on your own schedule.

Childcare, tutoring, elderly check-ins, pet minding, meal prep, light housekeeping, yard help, small errands, each with its own hourly rate. Offer something else? Write it in your own words and price it.
You can change your services and rates whenever you like. Any agreements you’ve already signed keep their original rate.
Becoming a Certified Mom Helper Is Simple
Photo, bio, services and rates. Say what you do in your own words.
Government ID, then request your Vulnerable Sector and record checks through Credibled.
Someone on our team reads your full file. Every approval is reviewed by a person, never automated.
Your Vetted badge appears and verified families nearby can find you.
Government photo ID, passport, driver’s licence or provincial card. You must be 18+.
Vulnerable Sector Check, the police check required for working with children and vulnerable adults.
Enhanced criminal record check, requested through Credibled from inside the app; you don’t need to visit a station.
Checks are fetched securely via our partner Credibled. Results go to a Poppynz admin, not to families.
First Aid / CPR, current certificate from a recognised provider.
Personal Support Worker (PSW), certificate, useful for elderly check-ins.
Credentials are verified by an admin and appear as tags on your profile. They’re not required to be approved.

The 15% service fee covers payments, written agreements, session tracking, messaging and support. No sign-up fee, no monthly fee, no charge for the background check request. Payouts in CAD after each tracked session.

Major-domo marks helpers with a sustained record on Poppynz, completed agreements, verified credentials, and a clean review history. It shows on your profile and tells families they’re talking to someone with a track record here.

content.value: Do I need to be a mother to be a Mom Helper?

editor_settings.title: Do I need to be a mother to be a Mom Helper?

content.value: No. “Mom Helper” is the name for the role, not a requirement. Students, retirees, care workers and parents of any kind all help on Poppynz. You must be 18 or older.

editor_settings.title: Do I need to be a mother to be a Mom Helper?

content.value: Who pays for the background check?

editor_settings.title: Who pays for the background check?

content.value: The record checks are requested through Credibled from inside the app; there is no Poppynz charge for the request. If Credibled or your province charges a processing fee, we tell you the amount before you start.

editor_settings.title: Who pays for the background check?

content.value: Identity and credential review is usually quick. Vulnerable Sector Checks depend on your local police service and can take from a few days to several weeks. You can build your profile while you wait.
